note: WP-39: what each role may run (command name patterns), beyond the read commands everyone has (dbe/team.py READ). 'approve' lists the commands that sign something off; a role runs one only if it lists it (or has '*'). 'never' takes commands away from a role that otherwise has them.

owner.about: the studio's owner: everything, including breaking locks and consent records

director.about: makes films: everything but legal records, environment builds and team membership; signs off films and posts
director.note_desk: the director's desk (desk.say) routes plain-English notes to the commands below

artist.about: draws and rigs characters, props, levels, fonts and packs; cannot sign off films or posts

reviewer.about: reviews films: notes, critic rounds and gate verdicts; changes no film data

editor.about: cuts, sound and delivery of films others made

animator.about: performs the characters: acting, timing of clips, camera on the timeline, previews and shot renders

critic.about: a fresh critic session: reads the film and its packet, records notes and critic rounds; changes nothing else

fact_checker.about: checks facts against sources: research gates and verdicts, corrections of facts; changes no picture or sound
